mintAuthority.summary: Only the controller holds the reviewed USDfr mint role; KYC user deposits and authorized yield issuance are checked against ReserveManager backing. Forest-Road-controlled governance can replace UUPS mint logic after a 172800-second timelock; collateral marks and loan facts rely on approved attesters.

review.evidence: Ethereum-only native issuance is controller-gated and backing-checked, with mutable logic behind a two-day timelock controlled by the Forest Road treasury. Continuous onchain ledger reconciliation is accounting, not financial assurance of receivables. Open issuer-disclosed LMV-09 and LMV-11 economic findings, and newer disclosed LMV-12 through LMV-16 findings, remain adverse reviewed operating context; no claim of completed remediation is made.
